notes.title: Galaxy Dreamer Release
notes.content:
Greetings, dear friends!

The Galaxy dreamer team is happy to announce the release of our project in early access. We have been preparing for this moment for a long time. At the moment, the main part of the work on the code and gameplay has been done, we are polishing individual mechanics and finalizing the narrative part. And now you can enjoy the game to the fullest and complete it.

Our plans for the next months:

 Steam integration: achievements and cloud saves.
 Improvements for the random run mode.
 New captains.
 And many more various gameplay improvements..

This is our first project and we will be glad to hear feedback from players. We are looking forward to your feedback.

Galactic dreamers, welcome aboard, your spaceship is waiting for you!
